Group A receives active implants on Days 0, 120, and 240 and placebo on Days 60, 180, and 300; Group B receives the reverse sequence.

study_schedule.source_excerpt: protocolSection.descriptionModule.briefSummary; protocolSection.outcomesModule.secondaryOutcomes[1]: "This was a phase III, multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled study, to evaluate the safety and efficacy of subcutaneous bioresorbable afamelanotide implants in patients with Erythropoietic Protoporphyria (EPP)." "The study was conducted with two parallel study arms with crossover between treatments every 60 days." "* Group A was administered active implants on Days 0, 120, 240 and placebo implants on Days 60, 180, 300" "* Group B was administered placebo implants on Days 0, 120, 240 and active implants on Days 60, 180, 300" "Changes in melanin density (MD) (measured by spectrophotometry) at each visit by group." "Day0, Day14, Day30, Day60, Day74, Day90, Day120, Day150, Day180, Day210, Day240, Day270, Day300, Day330, Day360 or Early Termination" -- The registry describes a double-blind crossover with treatment changes every 60 days and lists group-specific implant days. The melanin-density outcome says measurements were taken at each visit and lists assessment days from Day 0 through Day 360 (or early termination); the visit_days values copy the numeric parts of those explicit Day labels (no day-to-week conversion or arithmetic is used). Week-based phase boundaries and whole-study duration are left null because the cited registry text supplies day-based schedule details rather than those week values. The cited CT.gov record has narrative descriptions and outcome time frames, not a full per-visit schedule table, so full_visit_table_available is false.
